entities.summary: Bryan Cody Ransom is an American former professional baseball utility infielder. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the San Francisco Giants, Houston Astros, New York Yankees, Philadelphia Phillies, Arizona Diamondbacks, Milwaukee Brewers, San Diego Padres, and Chicago Cubs. He also played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Saitama Seibu Lions.
